title: Song
description: One song from the Codex Bruxellensis.

id.description: Stable slug derived from the title, e.g. 'antverpia-lied'. Suffix with -2, -3 on collisions.

title.description: Title as printed above the song, with accents normalised, e.g. 'À BAS LA CALOTTE'.

sortTitle.description: Title as it appears in the book's index, with leading articles moved to the end, e.g. 'SMIDJE, ’T'. Used for alphabetical ordering.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the lyrics, guessed from the section or the text. For songs in dialect, use the nearest language.

clubId.description: Only set for songs in the 'kringliederen' or 'officiele-liederen' section. References clubs.json.

pages.description: Printed page numbers (not PDF indexes). A song can span pages.

melody.description: Text after 'M:' in the book: a composer, or the song whose tune is borrowed.

notes.description: Other text printed between the title and the lyrics (history, 'Traditional, op de wijze van …', etc.).

stanza.description: A block of lines separated from the next by a blank line in the book, or a single printed instruction.

kind.description: 'verse' (upright text) and 'chorus' (italic text) carry lines. 'chorus-ref' is a printed 'Refrein …' instruction that repeats the chorus. 'direction' is any other stage direction, e.g. 'Ad fundum'.

repeats.description: Repeat markers on lines of this stanza. A marker next to one line covers that line; a bracketed marker covers several lines.

repeat.description: How many times the whole stanza is sung, e.g. 'Refrein (BIS)'. Omitted when 1.

instruction.description: Text of a 'direction', or the extra text of a 'chorus-ref', e.g. 'waarbij ‘zijnen’ door ‘uwen’ vervangen wordt.'

from.description: Index of the first line covered (0-based, inclusive).

to.description: Index of the last line covered (inclusive).

times.description: (BIS) = 2, (TER) = 3, (QUATER) = 4. Absent for non-numeric markers such as '(ULB)'.
